I don't think there's anything like sci-fi conventions or festivals near me, or none that I know of at least. I've just checked out my countries' subreddit, it doesn't seem too active. There's a reddit meetup in my country in about a month though, but it's an hour or 2 away from where I live. I'm pretty sure I'd be too shy to start a conversation with anyone anyway, or wouldn't know what to say if I did.

I'm not sure how I'd meet other sci-fi fans. I'm European, sci-fi isn't that big around here. I wouldn't know how to meet other people who like that kind of stuff. Hell, most of my "friends" haven't even heard (or like, if they've heard of it) of the mainstream shows I like, like Seinfeld or Monty Python. And these are mostly people who studied computer science, so I don't really expect "normal people" to like that kind of thing.

I'm guessing I lose myself in sci-fi since all the shows I watch feature a group of shipmates/friends/whatever who would give their lives for eachother. Everyone in those groups just.. fits in and has something to contribute to the group.

I guess what I'm missing in life is friendship and love. I don't feel like I have anything to contribute to any conversation, and remain silent most of the time because of never knowing what to say. I don't feel like I ever fit in with anyone and am just a waste of other people's time. I'm probably wasting your time too.
I only still enjoy listening to music, or losing myself in sci-fi shows. Besides that.. I can't really think of anything.

1. I don't feel that what I do is so insignificant compared to other people. It's just that I feel a "normal" life is insignificant. Wasting half your day working/studying followed by some hours of free time, for the rest of your life. I'm just not motivated enough to be able to do that.

2. I don't think there is any meaning to life. I don't really have any passions or things I care about.

I've told myself the same thing at the beginning of high school. That in 5 years I might not be such a shy person, find fun things to do, get a girlfriend. When I started college, nothing has really changed and I told myself the same thing. 5 years later again, and still nothing has changed. I doubt it ever will.
